label: axillary
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its arising in an axil, the upper angle between a leaf or bract and the stem that bears it.

label: leaf-opposed
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its arising from the stem on the side opposite the point of attachment of a leaf.

label: basal
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its arising at or near the base of its supporting stem or shoot system.

label: solitary
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its being borne individually at a particular attachment site rather than together with other structures of the same kind at that site.

label: paired
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its being borne together with one other structure of the same kind as a pair at a common node or closely associated attachment sites.

label: rosulate
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in a leaf or shoot system by virtue of the leaf belonging to, or the shoot system bearing, a dense radiating cluster of leaves on a shortened axis.

label: capitate
definition: An aggregated quality inhering in an inflorescence or flower by virtue of its flowers forming, or the flower belonging to, a compact head-like cluster on a shortened inflorescence axis.

label: caespitose
definition: An aggregated quality inhering in a whole plant or shoot system by virtue of its stems or shoots growing close together in a dense tuft or clump from the base.

label: creeping
definition: A prostrate quality inhering in a stem or plant by virtue of its growing along the surface of the ground and rooting at the nodes.

label: mat-forming
definition: A shape quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing low and spreading into a dense, flat mat over the ground.

label: twiggy
definition: A branched quality inhering in a whole plant or shoot by virtue of its bearing numerous slender, fine branches.

label: leafy
definition: A structural quality inhering in a whole plant or shoot by virtue of its bearing well-developed foliage leaves along its axes.

label: subsessile
definition: An attachment quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its being attached by a very short stalk, so that it is almost sessile.

label: bipinnate
definition: A pinnate quality inhering in a compound leaf by virtue of its primary divisions (pinnae) being themselves pinnate.

label: unisexual
definition: A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having functional stamens or functional carpels but not both; in an inflorescence, by virtue of all its flowers being of the same one sex.
review_note: 2026-11-08: bearer scope widened to inflorescences (unisexual inflorescences are standard flora usage) 2026-11-14: definition reworded after the second-model review of the definitions (Claude Opus; checked, AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: sweet-scented

label: spicy-scented

label: musty-smelling

label: monomorphic
definition: A morphological quality inhering in a set of homologous plant structures by virtue of its members occurring in a single form.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling and opposite of FLOPO:0991092 dimorphic; 'not dimorphic' would also cover trimorphic sets.

label: margined
definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a distinct marginal band that differs from the rest of it in colour, texture, thickness or cell form.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Covers narrowly margined seeds and bracts and the bordered (limbidiate) leaves of mosses; the band itself is a plant organ margin (PO:0025005).

label: wiry
definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being slender, tough and resilient, like wire.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991126 corky; combines slenderness with toughness, which PATO:0001545 inflexible does not.

label: callose
definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bearing hard, thickened, often pale spots or tips (calluses).
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Not the polysaccharide callose; 'callus' was rejected as a generic part, so this cannot be a presence rule.

label: appendiculate
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bearing one or more small outgrowths or appendages.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991029 horned and FLOPO:0991196 crested; the appendages of anthers, petals and peristome cilia have different origins, so no part is named.

label: mammillate
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bearing one or more nipple-shaped protuberances, broader and blunter than papillae.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991059 papillose; in mosses a mammilla is a bulge of the whole cell wall, a papilla a solid outgrowth. PATO:0002108 papillary is the bearer's itself resembling a nipple.

label: flat-topped
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's upper surface or outline being more or less level, its distal parts reaching about the same height.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). PATO:0002455 corymb-like is the inflorescence architecture; flat-topped cymes, panicles, fruits and moss lamella cells are not corymbs.

label: turgid
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being swollen and full, rounded in section rather than flattened, as if filled with fluid.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Not PATO:0001851 swollen or PATO:0001602 distended (abnormal), PATO:0002376 inflated (air-filled) or PATO:0001622 increased turgor (cell pressure).

label: homogamous
definition: A structural quality inhering in an inflorescence by virtue of all its flowers being of the same sexual kind.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Opposite of FLOPO:0991178 heterogamous. The pollination sense (anthers and stigmas maturing together, 'flowers homogamous') is a different quality and is not covered.

label: doubly serrate
definition: A serrated quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's marginal teeth bearing smaller teeth on their own margins.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Child of PATO:0001206 serrated; sibling of FLOPO:0991081 serrulate.

label: spathaceous
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a spathe: large, sheathing and enclosing, often split down one side.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991200 bract-like; a bract that is itself a spathe is the bearer FLOPO_0986007 spathe.

label: pustulate
definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's surface bearing small, rounded, blister-like elevations, often at the bases of hairs.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991060 tuberculate; smaller than FLOPO:0991122 bullate; not PATO:0001928 blistered, which is an accumulation of fluid.

label: scapiform
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being a long, leafless or nearly leafless axis arising at or near the base of the plant and bearing flowers at its tip, like a scape.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: gynaecandrous
definition: An androgynous quality inhering in an inflorescence by virtue of its pistillate flowers being borne above the staminate flowers on the same axis.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Child of FLOPO:0991037 androgynous, whose definition does not fix the order. In Carex usage 'androgynous' means the opposite order (staminate above), which would need a sibling class.

label: proliferous
definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's producing buds, shoots or plantlets from which new plants arise vegetatively.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Botany-specific (includes pseudoviviparous spikelets and root-suckering roots); PATO:0002102 proliferative is a cell-division quality.

label: bipinnatifid
definition: A pinnatifid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's pinnatifid lobes being themselves pinnatifid.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Follows FLOPO:0991014 bipinnate; sibling of FLOPO:0991155 pinnatisect.

label: hemi-epiphytic
definition: A positional quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing as an epiphyte for part of its life and rooted in the ground for the other part, either starting on a host and sending roots down to the soil or starting in the soil and later losing its connection with it.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991110 epiphytic; not a child of it, as the plant is not always epiphytic.

label: pandurate
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline being fiddle-shaped: obovate to oblong and contracted by a concave indentation on each side below the middle.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991024 ovate and FLOPO:0991056 obcordate; distinct from FLOPO:0991057 lyrate, which is a lobing.

label: spine-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a spine: narrow, rigid and ending in a sharp point.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991200 bract-like and FLOPO:0991143 scale-like; FLOPO:0991210 spine-tipped is a bearer that only ends in a spine.

label: fugacious
definition: A shedability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's falling or withering very early, soon after it is formed or the structure it subtends opens.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991181 marcescent and PATO:0001731 deciduous (plant), which is the shedding of foliage.

label: julaceous
definition: A cylindrical quality inhering in a leafy shoot by virtue of its leaves being closely imbricate and appressed, so that the shoot is smooth, round in section and catkin-like.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: aphyllopodic
definition: A structural quality inhering in a culm or fertile shoot by virtue of its lowest leaves being bladeless sheaths or having much reduced blades, the shoot usually arising laterally from beneath the leaves of a previous shoot.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: parted
definition: A split quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided more than halfway, but not fully, to its base or midrib into segments.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: glume-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a glume (PO:0009039): small, dry, chaffy and bract-like.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991200 bract-like and PATO:0002459 sepal-like, worded as they are.

label: obpyramidal
definition: A pyramidal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being attached at the apex of the pyramid, with the polygonal base distal.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: squarrose
definition: A spreading quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abruptly bent outward at or near its base, so that its free part stands out or recurves from the axis, as in phyllaries or moss leaves.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Child of PATO:0104356 spreading; differs from PATO:0002211 recurved in the abrupt bend near the base.

label: stipule-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a stipule.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991200 bract-like and PATO:0002459 sepal-like.

label: phyllopodic
definition: A structural quality inhering in a culm or fertile shoot by virtue of its lowest leaves bearing well-developed blades, the shoot arising from the centre of a leaf tuft.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: dolabriform
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like the head of a hatchet: narrow at the base and widening into a broad, oblique, curved distal edge.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: biternate
definition: A structural quality inhering in a compound leaf by virtue of its being divided into three primary divisions, each of which is again divided into three.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: collenchymatous
definition: A structural quality inhering in a cell or a structure made of cells by virtue of the cell walls being thickened at the corners where the cells meet, as in collenchyma.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). The bryological sense (leaf and exothecial cells); not the presence of PO:0005423 collenchyma tissue.

label: septate-nodulose
definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being partitioned internally by transverse septa that show on the surface as small nodules or cross-ridges.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Usual in Juncus, Cyperaceae and Poaceae leaves and culms; PATO has no septate quality.

label: colonial
definition: An aggregated quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its growing in a group of closely spaced shoots or individuals, usually spread vegetatively from one parent by rhizomes, stolons or root suckers.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: anadromous
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the first segment or vein of each division of the bearer arising on the acroscopic side, towards the apex of the frond.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Fern-specific; the opposite is catadromous.

label: pinnately branched
definition: A branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's branches arising in two rows on opposite sides of a main axis, like the barbs of a feather.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: flagelliform
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being long, slender and flexible, tapering like a whip lash.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991038 virgate (straight, stiff, wand-like); PATO:0104351 filiform is thread-like and not flexible-tapering.

label: mitrate
definition: A concave 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a mitre: a hollow, symmetric cone that is not split down one side, though it may be shortly lobed or split at the base on several sides.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling and contrast of FLOPO:0991119 cucullate (calyptra split on one side).

label: hair-pointed
definition: A pointed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ending in a long, slender, hair-like point, often hyaline.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: abortive
definition: A structural quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having stopped developing before maturity, so that it is present but reduced and usually non-functional.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: prorulose
definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's cells having their ends projecting as low, papilla-like protrusions (prorulae) above the surface.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: synoicous
definition: A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a bryophyte gametophyte by virtue of its bearing antheridia and archegonia mixed together in the same gametoecium.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991093 autoicous; bryophyte sexual system, distinct from flowering-plant monoecy.

label: excurved
definition: A curved quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outward, away from the axis or the centre of the structure that bears it.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). PATO:0002211 recurved (backward or inward) and PATO:0001597 everted (turned outward in placement, not curved) do not fit.

label: tooth-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a tooth: small, short, broad-based and pointed.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of FLOPO:0991143 scale-like and FLOPO:0991200 bract-like, worded as they are; not PATO:0001205 dentated, which is bearing teeth.

label: cyme-like
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's architecture resembling a cyme, a determinate inflorescence whose main axis ends in a flower and whose later flowers arise on lateral branches below it.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of PATO:0002455 corymb-like and FLOPO:0991199 thyrse-like.

label: spinose-serrate
definition: A serrated quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's marginal teeth each ending in a spine.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Child of PATO:0001206 serrated. Numbers before it ('5-12-spinose-serrate on each side') are a count of teeth (docs/odp/03-count-of-parts.md).

label: polygonal
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline or cross-section having several, usually five or more, straight sides meeting at angles.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: autotrophic
definition: A trophic quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its obtaining its carbon by its own photosynthesis, without depending on a host plant or on fungi.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Contrasts with mycoheterotrophic and parasitic; possibly outside PATO's scope, like FLOPO:0991110 epiphytic.

label: diadelphous
definition: A connate quality inhering in an androecium or its stamens by virtue of the stamen filaments being united into two separate groups, often 9 + 1 or 5 + 5.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: distylous
definition: A heterostylous quality inhering in a flower or plant by virtue of its belonging to a species whose flowers occur in two morphs, one with long styles and short stamens and one with short styles and long stamens.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of tristylous.

label: neuter
definition: A sterile quality inhering in a flower by virtue of its having neither functional stamens nor a functional gynoecium.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: septifragal
definition: A dehiscent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's opening at maturity by valves that break away from the septa, the septa remaining attached to the central axis.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: latiseptate
definition: A flattened quality inhering in a fruit by virtue of its being compressed parallel to the septum, so that the septum lies across the broadest diameter of the fruit.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Brassicaceae silicles; the opposite is angustiseptate (compressed at right angles to the septum). Sibling of FLOPO:0991103 depressed.

label: chasmogamous
definition: An open quality inhering in a flower by virtue of its opening at anthesis, so that its anthers and stigmas are exposed and it can be cross-pollinated.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: parasitic
definition: A trophic quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its obtaining water or nutrients, wholly or in part, from another living plant to which it is attached by haustoria.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: monocarpic
definition: A multi-cellular organismal disposition inhering in a plant by virtue of its flowering and fruiting only once and then dying.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: medifixed
definition: An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being attached at or near its middle, with free arms or ends on either side of the point of attachment.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: clonal
definition: A structural quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its spreading vegetatively, by rhizomes, stolons, roots or bulbs, into a group of genetically identical shoots or ramets.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Probably outside PATO's scope (how a plant grows and reproduces); kept in FLOPO beside mat-forming and caespitose.

label: hypogynous
definition: A positional quality inhering in a floral organ or flower by virtue of the perianth and stamens being inserted on the receptacle below the ovary and free from it.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: palmatipartite
definition: A split quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cut more than halfway, but not fully, to the base into segments radiating from a common point.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Palmate counterpart of FLOPO:0991156 pinnatipartite; sibling of FLOPO:0991160 pedate.

label: barrel-shaped
definition: A convex 3-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a barrel: roughly cylindrical, broadest at the middle with outwardly curved sides, and truncate at both ends.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of PATO:0001873 cylindrical and FLOPO:0991120 trigonous.

label: palmately divided
definition: A split quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cut into segments that radiate from a common point, the incisions reaching more than halfway to the base.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Palmate counterpart of FLOPO:0991156 pinnatipartite and FLOPO:0991155 pinnatisect; deeper than FLOPO:0991158 palmately lobed; parent of FLOPO:0991160 pedate. Not PATO:0001980 digitate, which is compound.

label: incumbent
definition: A positional quality inhering in the cotyledons of an embryo by virtue of their lying with the back of one cotyledon against the radicle, which is folded along it.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Botany-specific (Brassicaceae); accumbent, the radicle against the cotyledon edges, is its sibling.

label: pseudopeltate
definition: An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being attached just inside its basal margin, with the basal lobes overlapping so that it appears peltate.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Fern rhizome scales; sibling of FLOPO:0991107 peltate.

label: semi-elliptic
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline being half an ellipse, bounded on one side by a straight line along one of the ellipse's axes.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: phyllodioicous
definition: A reproductive quality of a bryophyte belonging to a sexual system in which dwarf male plants grow epiphytically on the leaves or tomentum of the female plants.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: locellate
definition: A structural quality inhering in an anther or anther theca by virtue of its locules being divided by septa into smaller chambers (locelli).
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: doubly toothed
definition: A dentated quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's marginal teeth themselves bearing smaller teeth.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: gonioautoicous
definition: An autoicous quality inhering in a bryophyte gametophyte by virtue of its male gametoecia being bud-like and borne in leaf axils on the same stem as, and usually just below, the female gametoecia.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Sibling of rhizautoicous and cladautoicous.

label: monoicous
definition: A phenotypic sex quality inhering in a bryophyte gametophyte by virtue of its bearing both antheridia and archegonia on the same individual.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: bistratose
definition: A stratified quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being two cell layers thick.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: palmatisect
definition: A dissected quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cut to or almost to the base into segments radiating from a common point.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2).

label: glandular-scaly
definition: A scaly quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with scales that are glands (peltate glandular trichomes).
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Child of PATO:0001804 scaly; same model as FLOPO:0991173 glandular-pubescent.

label: bipinnatisect
definition: A pinnatisect quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cut to the midrib into segments that are themselves cut to their midribs.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Follows FLOPO:0991155 pinnatisect, as FLOPO:0991014 bipinnate follows pinnate.

label: polygamodioecious
definition: A polygamous quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its bearing flowers of one sex together with some bisexual flowers, so that the species is functionally dioecious.
review_note: 2026-11-14: proposed by the second-model review (Claude Opus) and checked (AI review, Claude Fable 5.2). Child of FLOPO:0991177 polygamous; with FLOPO:0991072 dioecious.

label: ternately compound
definition: A structural quality inhering in a compound leaf by virtue of its being divided into three parts, each of which may again be divided into three, so that the leaflets are borne in threes.
